name: Morino Ibuki
source: The only daughter of the director of the Forest Clinic where Yusaku works. She is Yusaku's cousin, and at the beginning of the story, they meet again for the first time in eight years. She is honest and cheerful, and she calls Yusaku "Yuunii". She is studying to become a nurse. She is good at cooking.
